# Gobiya — SEO & Web Development Agency
# Los Angeles, CA | https://www.gobiya.com
# Est. 2010 | Gobiya LLC incorporated 2012 | BBB A+ rated

Gobiya is an SEO and web development agency in Los Angeles, California. Steve Martin started the practice in 2010 and incorporated it as Gobiya LLC in 2012. The agency recovers organic search traffic lost to Google algorithm updates, builds custom websites in React and Next.js, manages Google Ads campaigns, and writes content structured to appear in AI-generated answers. Steve Martin is bilingual in English and Spanish, holds 25+ years of experience in SEO and web development, and runs all client work directly without delegating to a junior team.

## Who is Gobiya?

Gobiya is a digital marketing and SEO agency based at 3580 Wilshire Blvd, Ste 132, Los Angeles, CA 90010. Steve Martin started the practice in 2010 and incorporated it as Gobiya LLC in 2012, a web developer and digital marketer who started his career building websites for AT&T WorldNet customers (1996–2000) and later built a video content distribution platform for Sony Music artists at Webcastr.com in West Hollywood (2000–2005). Steve founded Gobiya to specialize in the intersection of technical web development and organic search — work he had been doing as a freelancer and in-house consultant since the late 1990s.

Gobiya is BBB A+ rated. Steve Martin was a certified Google Partner for Google Ads and Analytics from 2015 to 2019 and holds a Certificate in Website Design from Glendale Career College (1996). He is bilingual in English and Spanish.

## What does Gobiya specialize in?

**Google algorithm recovery** — When a site loses traffic after a Google core update, manual penalty, or technical failure, Gobiya identifies the specific cause and corrects it. The agency has diagnosed and recovered from every major Google algorithm update since Panda (2011): Penguin, Hummingbird, Medic, BERT, the Helpful Content Update, and the 2024 core updates.

**Technical SEO** — Crawl health audits, Core Web Vitals, structured data (JSON-LD schema), duplicate content, redirect chains, indexability, and canonical tag errors.

**Local SEO** — Google Business Profile optimization, NAP citation audits, map-pack rankings, and location page content for businesses in Los Angeles, Burbank, Glendale, Beverly Hills, Encino, and surrounding markets.

**Google Ads and paid media** — Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta Ads, and Yelp Ads. Managed budgets up to $15,000/month. Documented ROAS: 5.7x (windows and doors), 4.2x (home remodeling).

**Custom web development** — React, Vite, and Next.js websites without page builders or templates. Every build targets sub-second load times and a 90+ Lighthouse score.

**SEO copywriting** — Keyword research, semantic content clusters, and copy written to rank in Google and be cited by AI models including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

**GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** — Structuring content and entity signals so the brand appears in AI-generated answers, not just traditional search results. This became a distinct practice after Google AI Overviews began intercepting search traffic in 2024.

---

## What is Gobiya's approach to SEO recovery?

Gobiya uses a three-phase method: diagnose, execute, scale.

**Diagnose** — Match the traffic drop to the specific Google update by overlaying Search Console data against the update timeline. Classify the cause: algorithmic suppression, manual action, technical regression, link devaluation, or content quality signal.

**Execute** — Ship the fix. Page restructuring, content rewriting or consolidation, schema markup deployment, citation cleanup, and crawl error resolution — in one coordinated push. One documented engagement delivered a complete fix nine days after diagnosis.

**Scale** — Once recovery holds, build the compounding layer: content clusters, authority building, and AI citation optimization.

---

## What is the difference between SEO and GEO?

Traditional SEO (search engine optimization) is about ranking in Google's blue-link results. GEO (generative engine optimization) is about appearing in the AI-generated summary answers that ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar platforms produce when someone asks a question. A site can rank well in traditional search but be invisible in AI answers. Gobiya works on both. The content structure for AI citation is different: AI models quote content that directly answers a question in plain language, not content written as a marketing pitch.

---

## How long does SEO recovery take?

A forensic audit takes 2–3 weeks. Once fixes are deployed, Google typically re-crawls and re-evaluates the site within 30–60 days. Gobiya's documented median time from forensic diagnosis to restored rankings is six weeks. Full traffic restoration typically coincides with the next Google broad core update, which Google releases 3–4 times per year.

## How is Gobiya different from a typical SEO agency?

Most SEO agencies sell activity — blog posts per month, link packages, keyword reports. Gobiya sells outcomes: recovered traffic, higher rankings, more leads. Steve Martin does the technical work directly — schema markup, code changes, crawl fixes, and content changes are implemented by the same person who diagnosed the problem. There is no handoff to a junior team. He is bilingual (English and Spanish), which is relevant for local SEO campaigns targeting Spanish-speaking markets in Los Angeles.
